notes: Merged from two mentions in [0090]: 在制备环磺酮过程中 and 低危险性化学品制备环磺酮. It is the compound this patent prepares, so commercially_available is false. is_section_product is false because [0090] is a closing comparison paragraph and is not headed by a compound. The paragraph claims 较高的收率 (a comparatively high yield) but prints no figure, so yield_pct stays null. 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name for the herbicide tembotrione and resolves unambiguously; the tags are derived from that resolved identity and from the name itself, since no structure is drawn in this section.

Named in [0090] as the brominating agent (溴化剂) used in place of 溴素. role and compound_class follow that stated function rather than its identity as an acid. Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true. hazard:corrosive follows from the chemistry of concentrated hydrobromic acid; the paragraph itself presents it as the 低毒性、低危险性 alternative and does not warn about it.

Named in [0090] as the brominating agent that 氢溴酸 replaces, so it belongs to the superseded route and not to this process. 溴素 is the standard Chinese term for elemental bromine and resolves unambiguously. Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true. Hazard tags follow the standing rule for bromine.

Named in [0090] as one of the 危险化学品 this process avoids using, so it belongs to the compared route and not to this one. The paragraph states no function for it; role and compound_class are assigned from its identity as a common reaction solvent. Bulk commodity solvent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true. The hazard tags are supported by the paragraph calling it a 危险化学品 and by the standard flammability and toxicity of acetonitrile.

Named in [0090] as one of the 危险化学品 this process avoids using, so it belongs to the compared route and not to this one. The paragraph states no function for it; role and compound_class are assigned from its identity as a strong alkoxide base. Bulk commodity reagent that no step of this patent prepares, so commercially_available is true. hazard:corrosive is supported by the paragraph calling it a 危险化学品 and by the chemistry of sodium methoxide; no further hazard value is emitted because the text supports none.
